Free registry source inspected. Countdown and in-view number examples are demo-oriented; original Cojeev adaptation should build on existing animated-number. Registry dependency metadata omits imported packages.
Pointer pause, reset, keyboard resume, and second-panel value 500 observed. Pause label remains Pause timer while paused.
Four demonstration scenes: Number Flow countdown with pause/reset; spring-based in-view 500; twelve random poses ending at 2146000; in-view Number Flow with prefix/suffix.

A reusable value-driven span instead of timers or random data. Callers own countdown state; from supplies a one-time visible entrance. Twelve deterministic poses convey a drawn count without inventing random financial values.
